diagnostic.question: In a new patient situation (variant 7), someone with active intracranial hemorrhage is asking for therapeutic IV heparin; can it be given?
diagnostic.generated_answer:
Yes, but only if the patient has been on Heparin therapy for at least 30 days prior to the procedure.
A variant 7 patient requires Heparin therapy before any surgical intervention. The patient should have had Heparin therapy for at least 30 days prior to the procedure.
